facts.text: Everybody deserves one good night. Dinner first, then we push the table back and dance. Even this town.
facts.why: No quote page opened has this line, and in the film the dance is not at the town hall. The prom is held in a grain mill just over the county line, out of Bomont's reach. It reads as an invented quote.
facts.fix: Use a note: Dinner first. Then we take the party to the grain mill, just over the county line, where nobody can stop us.
